newsitem.title: USA: Playboy sees higher Q2 net.
newsitem.headline: Playboy sees higher Q2 net.

text.p: Playboy Enterprises Inc said Thursday it expects to report net income for the fiscal second quarter ended December 31 of about $2.8 million, or $0.14 a share, up from year-ago earnings of $1.1 million, or $0.06 a share.
Playboy said it expects operating income of $5.3 million, up from $2.9 million a year ago.

"We expect to report second quarter earnings of approximately $0.14 per share, which is above the high end of analysts' projections and substantially greater than the $0.06 per share we reported last year," said Chairman and Chief Executive Christie Hefner.

"The earnings growth is driven by significant increases in entertainment and catalog operating profit as well as continued growth in the international publishing business compared to the same period last year," she said.
Playboy said it expects to report full second quarter results in late January.
